component.name: Cuprita
component.summary: PCB and schematic editor for KiCad projects

description.p: A fast PCB and schematic editor for KiCad projects: open the project you have or start one, and take it from the schematic to the fab's files in one window. Files stay KiCad's, saved byte for byte where you didn't change them.

ul.li: Schematic: symbols from KiCad's libraries, wires, labels, sheets, buses, electrical rule checks and simulation in ngspice.
Board: placing, routing with other nets making way, zones, the outline, design rule checks as you edit, 3D.
Make: what an order still needs, Gerber and drill files, the BOM and positions that JLCPCB, PCBWay and OSH Park take.
Ask: questions about the project answered by a model on this computer (Ollama).
